verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing SaaS with SDKs and a dashboard, so letting users opt out of the vendor's own telemetry is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack does not document any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The usage-event ingestion and metering docs describe Orb tracking its customers' end-user usage for billing, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
